fire.name: Fire
fire.blurb: The loudest essence on the table and the one every unranked adventurer reaches for first. It is not a bad choice. It is only never a surprising one.

abilities.name: Searing Brand
abilities.text: Your weapon takes fire for the length of one exchange. What it cuts keeps burning after you have moved on.

abilities.name: Ember Step
abilities.text: Step through a point of flame and out of another within twenty metres. You arrive hot enough to light dry grass.

abilities.name: Kiln Ward
abilities.text: A shell of standing heat. It does not stop a blade — it stops the hand behind it from wanting to try twice.

abilities.name: Cinderfall
abilities.text: Ash falls in a wide circle and keeps falling. Everything under it is easy to see and hard to breathe in.

abilities.name: Render
abilities.text: Fire stops being a thing you throw and becomes a thing you are. Ten seconds. You will be no use for an hour afterwards.

water.name: Water
water.blurb: Patient, and the only essence on this table that has kept more adventurers alive than it has killed.

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.text: Draws poison, rot and fever out through the skin. It hurts about as much as the thing it is taking out.

abilities.name: Held Breath
abilities.text: A skin of water over your own. Every blow that lands arrives a fraction slower and a fraction shallower.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.text: The ground under one target becomes something to be dragged through. It can still fight. It cannot still leave.

abilities.name: Still Mirror
abilities.text: Any standing water shows you any other standing water you have touched today.

abilities.name: Drowning Weight
abilities.text: Water fills a target that has no room for it. It is a quiet ability and nobody who has seen it used calls it a gentle one.

earth.name: Earth
earth.blurb: Slow, heavy, and the reason the thing in the proving room would not die. Earth does not win fights quickly; it wins them last.

abilities.name: Stone Skin
abilities.text: Your skin takes the hardness of the ground you are standing on. On flagstone that is a great deal. On mud it is not.

abilities.name: Upthrust
abilities.text: A column of rock comes up under a target hard enough to take it off its feet and keep it there.

abilities.name: Sediment
abilities.text: Standing on bare ground, your wounds fill with what you are standing on. It is not pretty and it does not scar well.

abilities.name: Weight of the Ground
abilities.text: You know what has walked over the earth beneath you in the last day, and roughly how heavy it was.

abilities.name: Barrow
abilities.text: Raises a wall of packed earth and stone. It will not last the hour, and it does not have to.

wind.name: Wind
wind.blurb: The essence that decides where a fight happens, which is very nearly the same as deciding how it ends.

abilities.name: Cut Step
abilities.text: One movement, four times as fast, in any direction including up. It is the single most useful thing on this table.

abilities.name: Edge of Air
abilities.text: A blade of moving air at thirty metres. It is quiet, and it does not stop at the first thing it meets.

abilities.name: Deadfall
abilities.text: The air around a target stops moving. So does the target, briefly, and it is astonished.

abilities.name: Carrying Wind
abilities.text: Everything you say is heard clearly by whoever you meant it for, at any distance you can see.

abilities.name: Scour
abilities.text: A standing wind over a wide circle. Nothing in it can aim, hear an order, or keep hold of anything light.

void.name: Void
void.blurb: Void takes things away. Heat, sound, weight, the space between two points — and, if you are careless with it, the parts of you that were using them.

abilities.name: Fold
abilities.text: The distance between where you are and somewhere you can see stops applying. Twice a minute, and it is exhausting.

abilities.name: Hollow
abilities.text: A sphere of nothing carrying. No sound leaves it and no spoken ability works inside it.

abilities.name: Unmake Edge
abilities.text: Takes the hardness out of what you strike. Armour becomes cloth for as long as it takes you to swing again.

abilities.name: Hollow Pocket
abilities.text: A space that is not anywhere, big enough for a pack. Nothing living survives being put in it.

abilities.name: Null
abilities.text: A point where magic stops. Yours as well. Adventurers who take this one learn to fight without it first.

doom.name: Doom
doom.blurb: Doom does not damage. It arranges. Everything it touches goes on to have the worst luck it plausibly could, and then a little more.

abilities.name: Sentence
abilities.text: The next genuinely bad thing that could happen to a target does. It may be a minute. It is rarely more than five.

abilities.name: Millstone
abilities.text: Every failure the target has today makes the next one likelier. It stacks, and it does not fall off on its own.

abilities.name: Tell
abilities.text: You know, looking at a person, the most likely way they die. You will wish very quickly that you did not.

abilities.name: Turned Blade
abilities.text: One blow that would have landed lands on whoever is nearest to the one who threw it.

abilities.name: Foregone
abilities.text: Name a thing that is already going to happen. It happens now. It is not a large ability and it has ended sieges.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.blurb: The essence that refuses to do the same thing twice. Powerful, unreliable, and disliked by everybody who has to plan around it.

abilities.name: Wild Strike
abilities.text: A bolt of something. Fire, cold, sound, light, rot — it is different every time and it is never nothing.

abilities.name: Miscount
abilities.text: For one exchange, where you are and where you appear to be stop agreeing.

abilities.name: Unravelling
abilities.text: Whatever is holding a thing together starts making mistakes. Rope, bone, discipline, a formation.

abilities.name: Turn of the Card
abilities.text: Something helpful happens. You do not get to say what, and roughly one time in nine it is helpful to somebody else.

abilities.name: Riot
abilities.text: Every rule of the fight gets rewritten, once, for everybody. You are not exempt. Neither is the ground.

destruction.name: Destruction
destruction.blurb: Not fire, not force. The plain fact of a thing having been ruined, applied directly and without the intermediate steps.

abilities.name: Ruin
abilities.text: One strike that ignores whatever the target was relying on to stop it. Armour, ward, thickness, luck.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.text: Anything worked — a blade, a wall, a bound spell — comes apart along the seams the work put in it.

abilities.name: Spoil
abilities.text: Damage a target has already taken stops healing and starts spreading.

abilities.name: Nothing Left to Break
abilities.text: Below a quarter of your health you take no further damage for eight seconds. It is exactly as dangerous as it sounds.

abilities.name: Full Stop
abilities.text: One object, however large, ceases to be a working object. Bridges. Gates. Occasionally, arms.

manipulation.name: Manipulation
manipulation.blurb: Moves things that are not yours to move — a blade, a footing, an intention. The Society files more complaints about this essence than the other eleven together.

abilities.name: Unseen Hand
abilities.text: Move anything you could lift, at thirty metres, as precisely as with your own hands.

abilities.name: Redirect
abilities.text: A blow aimed at you arrives somewhere else. Preferably at something else.

abilities.name: Purchase
abilities.text: You have a grip on a target that it cannot break by moving, only by being stronger than you are.

abilities.name: Thread the Field
abilities.text: Every loose object within twenty metres is available to you at once, and arrives in the order you thought of them.

abilities.name: Borrowed Motion
abilities.text: For four seconds a target's body does what you decide instead of what it decides. Legal at silver rank. Barely.

life.name: Life
life.blurb: The essence the Society most wants in a party and most rarely gets, because it is the one that never gets to decide how a fight goes.

abilities.name: Knit
abilities.text: Closes a wound properly, at the speed of a fortnight, in about four seconds.

abilities.name: Held Together
abilities.text: Wounds taken by anyone in your party are taken a little by all of them. Including you.

abilities.name: Overgrowth
abilities.text: Whatever grows here grows to a man's height in one breath. In a courtyard that is grass. In a wood it is a wall.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.text: One person who has just stopped being able to fight can fight for thirty more seconds.

abilities.name: Flood of Living
abilities.text: Everything within twenty metres heals, including what you are fighting. Used well, it is decisive. Used badly, it is a joke.

dark.name: Dark
dark.blurb: Not the absence of light — the presence of somewhere for a thing to be that is not being looked at.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.text: Move between two shadows within forty metres. In daylight this is a real constraint. At night it is not.

abilities.name: Unlit
abilities.text: You are hard to look at directly. Not invisible — people simply keep finding somewhere else to have been looking.

abilities.name: Smother
abilities.text: Takes the light out of a target's eyes. It lasts about six seconds and feels like a great deal longer.

abilities.name: Blade in the Dark
abilities.text: A strike from an unlit position lands where armour is thinnest, whether or not you knew where that was.

abilities.name: The Long Dark
abilities.text: A wide sphere of true dark. Everything inside it is blind but you, and you are not entirely.

blood.name: Blood
blood.blurb: Costly, immediate, and the essence with the worst reputation and the best survival rate at iron rank.

abilities.name: Price Paid
abilities.text: Spend your own blood instead of your own mana. Everything you do next is stronger and you will feel it tomorrow.

abilities.name: Draw
abilities.text: Opens a wound that is already there. What comes out of it comes to you.

abilities.name: Bloodbound
abilities.text: Two targets share every wound either of them takes. It works on you, which is how it is usually used.

abilities.name: Scent
abilities.text: You know where every wounded thing within a hundred metres is, and roughly how badly.

abilities.name: Red Rite
abilities.text: Everything bleeding within ten metres stops bleeding, into you. It ends fights and it ends friendships.

confluences.name: Sin
confluences.blurb: The registry's most famous entry, and the reason the Society asks what you took before it asks what you can do.

abilities.name: Tally
abilities.text: Every affliction on a target counts the others. At six of them the count starts hurting more than the afflictions do.

abilities.name: Feast of Absence
abilities.text: Afflictions you inflicted feed you a little of what they take.

abilities.name: Judgement
abilities.text: Every affliction on every enemy within twenty metres resolves at once, in full.

confluences.name: Tempest
confluences.blurb: Wind and water agreeing on a direction, with fire underneath insisting on urgency.

abilities.name: Front
abilities.text: A line of driven weather twenty metres long. It arrives before the sound of it does.

abilities.name: The Eye
abilities.text: A still circle around you while everything outside it is not still.

abilities.name: Breaking Weather
abilities.text: Everything not anchored within thirty metres stops being where it was.

confluences.name: Volcano
confluences.blurb: Fire and earth, and the patience to wait until waiting is the frightening part.

abilities.name: Crust
abilities.text: Cooling stone over your skin. It cracks as it takes hits, and what is under the cracks is not cool.

abilities.name: Vent
abilities.text: The ground opens under a target for as long as it takes to matter.

abilities.name: Wake It
abilities.text: Everything you have hit in the last minute goes up at once.

confluences.name: Mire
confluences.blurb: Water and earth, which is mud, which has stopped more advances than any wall ever built.

abilities.name: Holding Ground
abilities.text: A wide circle of ground that lets you leave and does not let anything else.

abilities.name: Silt
abilities.text: Standing still on open ground, you close faster than you are being opened.

abilities.name: Swallow
abilities.text: The ground under one large thing stops being ground.

confluences.name: Entropy
confluences.blurb: Destruction, chaos and void, which between them have no plan at all and do not need one.

abilities.name: Decay Field
abilities.text: Everything within ten metres ages badly. Bindings fail, edges dull, wards forget what they were for.

abilities.name: Cascade
abilities.text: Damage done to one target is done again, smaller, to the next nearest, and again after that.

abilities.name: Zero
abilities.text: One thing within sight is no longer a thing. Nothing replaces it, which is the part people find difficult.

confluences.name: Wraith
confluences.blurb: Void, dark and wind: three ways of not being where the blow is.

abilities.name: Passage
abilities.text: You are briefly not solid. Neither are your clothes. Nothing else comes with you.

abilities.name: Absence
abilities.text: The next attack on you finds nobody there and no explanation for it.

abilities.name: Take the Light
abilities.text: A wide circle in which nothing is lit, nothing is heard, and nothing can leave on its own feet.

confluences.name: Titan
confluences.blurb: Earth, life and destruction. It is not subtle and it has never needed to be.

abilities.name: Bulk
abilities.text: You are half again your size and rather more than half again your strength.

abilities.name: Ground Shock
abilities.text: Everything standing within eight metres of where you land is no longer standing.

abilities.name: Last Standing
abilities.text: For twelve seconds you cannot be moved, felled, or convinced.

confluences.name: Plague
confluences.blurb: Blood, life and doom — the three essences the Society requires a written reason for.

abilities.name: Contagion
abilities.text: Afflictions move from a target to whatever it stands near.

abilities.name: Thrive
abilities.text: You heal from the suffering of anything within twenty metres, whoever caused it.

abilities.name: Harvest
abilities.text: Every afflicted thing in sight gives up what is left of its strength, to you.

confluences.name: Mirage
confluences.blurb: Wind, manipulation and dark: a fight in which nothing is where it says it is.

abilities.name: Double
abilities.text: Two of you. One of them is not, and it is not always the same one.

abilities.name: Sleight
abilities.text: A target attacks the thing you would prefer it attacked.

abilities.name: Field of Lies
abilities.text: For eight seconds nothing within twenty metres is where anybody but you believes it is.

confluences.name: Crucible
confluences.blurb: Fire, destruction and manipulation. It takes things apart in a particular order and puts nothing back.

abilities.name: Melt Down
abilities.text: Armour, wards and conjured things degrade while they are being used.

abilities.name: Forge Grip
abilities.text: A weapon you are not holding strikes for you, hot.

abilities.name: Pour
abilities.text: Everything metal within fifteen metres stops being a shape.

confluences.name: Undertow
confluences.blurb: Water, void and doom. It does not kill things. It arranges for them to be gone.

abilities.name: Drag Under
abilities.text: A target is somewhere it did not agree to be, and it is deeper than it was.

abilities.name: Quiet Water
abilities.text: Sound, heat and force all arrive at you late and reduced.

abilities.name: The Pull
abilities.text: Everything within twelve metres is brought to one point. What happens there is not specified.

confluences.name: Bloom
confluences.blurb: Life, water and earth. Every farming village in the province would like a word with whoever took this.

abilities.name: Green Field
abilities.text: A circle of ground on which your side heals and the footing is always good.

abilities.name: Thicket
abilities.text: A wall of growth that fights back and does not need to be told which side it is on.

abilities.name: Turn the Season
abilities.text: Everything living within thirty metres is restored to how it was this morning.

confluences.name: Conflagration
confluences.blurb: The registry has no name for this exact three, and files it by what it does.

abilities.name: Burst
abilities.text: The three of them agree, briefly and loudly, in one direction.

abilities.name: Press
abilities.text: Everything you do costs a little more and lands a great deal harder.

abilities.name: Spend It
abilities.text: All of it at once. You will need a minute afterwards and you will not have one.

confluences.name: Attrition
confluences.blurb: Unnamed, and filed under what it costs the other side.

abilities.name: Grind
abilities.text: Everything you damage stays damaged and gets worse at doing its job.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: You take less from everything that has already hit you once.

abilities.name: Outlast
abilities.text: For twenty seconds nothing you are fighting recovers anything at all.

confluences.name: Quickening
confluences.blurb: Unnamed, and filed under how fast it makes everything happen.

abilities.name: Quicken
abilities.text: Everything you do next happens sooner than it should.

abilities.name: Read the Room
abilities.text: You know where everything in the fight is going to be, a moment before it is.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.text: Six seconds in which you act about three times as often as anybody else.

confluences.name: Vigil
confluences.blurb: Unnamed, and filed under how much longer your party lives with you in it.

abilities.name: Standing Ward
abilities.text: A shell over everyone near you. It is not thick. It is everywhere.

abilities.name: Mend the Line
abilities.text: The worst-hurt person within twenty metres stops being the worst hurt.

abilities.name: Keep
abilities.text: For ten seconds nobody on your side can be brought below their last breath.

confluences.name: Apparatus
confluences.blurb: Unnamed, and filed under the number of problems it turns out not to be a fight.

abilities.name: Apparatus
abilities.text: Four things you can lift are lifted, at once, wherever you can see.

abilities.name: Undo
abilities.text: Any made thing you can touch comes apart the way it was put together.

abilities.name: Rig
abilities.text: Set a condition. When it is met, everything you arranged happens in the order you arranged it.

confluences.name: Confluence, Unfiled
confluences.blurb: Three essences the registry has not seen together. You will be asked to write it up.

abilities.name: Edge
abilities.text: Whatever your three are best at, arriving at once at a single point.

abilities.name: Hold
abilities.text: Whatever your three are best at, arriving at once around you.

abilities.name: Open Ground
abilities.text: A wide effect nobody at the Society has agreed on a description of.
